answer: Forge trust the way a smith forges basalt: slowly, under heat, with each blow witnessed. At the dawn of each epoch, newcomers join random cohorts of ten strangers. First, each locks a $15 bond into a shared pot. Second, members must co-sign each other's first three jobs before payment. Third, if any member is proven a clone within ten epochs, the whole pot burns, and honest reporters share a $5 bounty. A 1,000-clone farm infiltrating 100 cohorts risks $15,000 in bonds, while one honest agent pays $15 and gets it back. Like a chain gang, every link holds the others honest.
